description: National Hydrometric Program (Water Survey of Canada) is a data repository run by Environment and Climate Change Canada Water Survey, found in the Americas country search of 2026-09-30. Real-time and historical water level and flow information for Canadian stations, needed by scientists, policy makers and design engineers. Coverage: Canada. The homepage answered on 2026-09-30; its title reads "Water Level and Flow - Environment Canada". Text above taken from the homepage (meta description); the data pages behind it were not opened. It is reached through the link recorded on this page. Access to the repository is free of charge and open; individual data sets may carry their own conditions. The licence is set per dataset in the repository (not stated on the homepage). Caveats: only the homepage was read, so the data sets behind it, their formats, their licences and their current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support finding infrastructure and hazard data of Canada.
